app.title: Dental Adventure
app.subtitle: Your first dental mission!
parent.whichVisit: Which visit is your child having?
milo.welcome: Hello there, {name}! Today we're going on a trip to the dental clinic.
milo.praise.2: Look at that — it's shiny now!
milo.praise.3: Lovely. That tickled the tooth a little!
milo.praise.4: Bravo, tooth hero — you have such gentle hands!
clinic.title: Meet the Dental Clinic
clinic.intro: First we're going to get to know some of the things here in the clinic. Press on each one, {name}, and it will tell you what it does.
clinic.chair.name: The Big Comfy Chair
clinic.chair.desc: I'm the dental chair. I'm like a swing — I go up and I come down, so you stay comfy and happy while we fight the sugar bugs.
clinic.light.name: The Sunshine Light
clinic.light.desc: I shine like the warm sunshine, so we can see your teeth nice and clearly.
clinic.suction.name: Thirsty Straw
clinic.suction.desc: I'm Mister Thirsty. I'm like a straw — I sip the water out of your mouth, so no sugar bugs go down into your tummy.
clinic.syringe.name: Wind and Water Wand
clinic.syringe.desc: I puff water and air onto your teeth, to wash them well and dry them off.
clinic.sink.name: The Little Sink
clinic.sink.desc: I'm the little sink! Come rinse and spit right here to keep your mouth nice and clean. 💧
clinic.table.name: The Tool Table
clinic.table.desc: I'm the tool table! All the little helpers sit on me, clean and ready, until it's their turn. 🧰
clinic.done: You explored the whole clinic, {name}! Amazing!
tools.title: Meet the Friendly Tools
tools.intro: Let's play a game, {name}. Scratch the colours in front of you, and each tool will appear and tell you what it does.
tools.groupDone: You met this whole team! Look how shiny the tooth is getting!
tools.done: You met all the tools, {name}! They can't wait to help your teeth!
tool.mirror.name: Dental Mirror
tool.mirror.desc: I'm the mirror. We look in me to see your teeth clearly, from every side.
tool.mirror.fact: It feels smooth and cool, like a little spoon.
tool.explorer.name: Tooth Checker
tool.explorer.desc: I'm the tooth counter. I count your teeth one by one and make sure no sugar bugs are hiding in them.
tool.explorer.fact: You might feel a tiny tickle when it taps.
tool.suction.name: Thirsty Straw
tool.suction.desc: I'm a straw! I drink up the water in your mouth. 🥤
tool.suction.fact: It makes a funny slurp sound, like the end of a milkshake!
tool.syringe.name: Wind and Water Wand
tool.syringe.desc: I puff air and water to rinse your teeth. 💦
tool.syringe.fact: The air feels cold, like a tiny wind on your tooth.
tool.brush.name: Polishing Brush
tool.brush.desc: I'm the little tooth shower. I sprinkle lots and lots of water to wash your teeth really well and take away any sugar bugs.
tool.brush.fact: It buzzes and tickles a little, and your teeth feel super smooth after.
tool.xray.name: Tooth Camera
tool.xray.desc: I take a quick photo inside your tooth. 📸
tool.xray.fact: You just stay still like a statue for one moment. That's all!
tool.ring.name: Tooth Hugger Ring
tool.ring.desc: I give your tooth a gentle hug. 🤗
tool.ring.fact: You'll feel a little push, like a snug sock for your tooth.
tool.umbrella.name: Tooth Umbrella
tool.umbrella.desc: I open around your tooth to keep it dry. ☂️
tool.umbrella.fact: Your tooth stays cozy and dry under its umbrella.
tool.spray.name: Sleepy Juice
tool.spray.desc: I'm the magic juice. I get sprayed on the tooth to send the sugar bugs to sleep, so we can catch them and they can't run around your mouth.
tool.spray.fact: It tastes a little like fruit, and your tooth feels sleepy and relaxed.
practice.brush.title: Make the Tooth Sparkle
practice.brush.intro: Oh no, {name} — this tooth has sticky spots! Grab the brush and clean them all!
practice.brush.done: Wow! You made it sparkle, {name}! What a clean tooth!
prepare.title: Prepare the Tooth
prepare.intro: Now let's try together, {name}, how we take those sugar bugs off your tooth.
prepare.step.ring: First, the Tooth Hugger Ring. Tap it to give the tooth a gentle hug!
prepare.step.umbrella: Now the Tooth Umbrella! Tap it to keep the tooth dry.
prepare.step.spray: First step: spray the magic juice on the tooth, to send the sugar bugs to sleep.
prepare.step.brush: Second step: use the little shower to take the sugar bugs off the tooth.
prepare.step.scrub: Press each sticky spot and I'll wash it clean!
prepare.done: There — you took away every sugar bug, and the tooth is strong again. Very well done, {name}.
spray.title: Quiet Counting Mission
spray.intro: The tooth wants a quiet little rest, {name}. You can close your eyes if you like. Count with me, slowly, to ten.
spray.done: Great counting with me, {name}! The tooth feels calm and cozy now.
visit.title: Your Dental Visit
visit.meetDr: Now let's meet the dentist who will be with you in the clinic. Hello, {name}! I'm your dentist. You'll always find me wearing a mask — but I'm smiling at you underneath it. Try pressing on it.
visit.maskPrompt: Your dentist is wearing a mask. Tap it when you're ready.
visit.maskOff: See? I'll be smiling at you the whole time, as long as you're my brave hero.
visit.stopSignal: You and I are going to be friends and fight the sugar bugs together, {name}. I'll help your teeth grow strong and beautiful again. So here is our agreement: you're a brave hero, you'll sit in the dental chair, and if anything bothers you at all, you raise your hand — and I will stop straight away. Let's try it together now.
visit.handPrompt: Raise your hand when you want your dentist to pause.
visit.simulation: Now let's go through all the steps together, from the moment you come into the clinic.
visit.step.chair: First step: you'll sit on the dental chair. It's a lovely chair, and it goes up and it comes down.
visit.step.light: Then I'll turn on the light, so I can see your teeth nice and clearly.
visit.step.mirror: After that I'll use the mirror, to see your teeth from every direction.
visit.step.sleepy: And when I know where the sugar bugs are, I'll spray the magic juice on them, so they go to sleep and I can take them away.
visit.step.count: This juice is only for the sugar bugs, so close your eyes for me and count along from one to ten.
visit.countToTen: One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten.
visit.juiceCount: This juice is just for the sticky spot. Close your eyes and count with me from one to ten. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
visit.step.clean: After that I'll use the little shower, to wash your teeth really well and take away every sugar bug, so they're strong and beautiful again.
visit.done: And that's the whole visit, {name}! You knew every single step!
reward.hero: You are now a DENTAL HERO!
reward.narration: Wow! We've finished our trip to the dental clinic. And here is a certificate with your name on it, {name}, because you were so brilliant today.
cert.title: Dental Hero Certificate
cert.for: for learning what happens at the dentist
story.calmer1: Very well done, {name}. You've finished the first step — you know the main things in the clinic now.
story.calmer2: That's the second step of our trip done. You're really getting to know the dental clinic.
story.calmer3: Wow! You took away all the sugar bugs and the tooth is strong again. Very well done, {name}.
story.reversal: You helped me get ready, {name}. Now I'll stay right beside you while you practise your visit!
ui.startOverConfirm: Tap again to restart from the beginning
